name: What Day Is It?
source: A girl wakes up in a basement, finding herself stripped naked. She is momentarily confused about her situation, but soon it becomes clear. A naked man towered over her, grinning with the most lecherous face she has seen. Her worst fears have come to reality. There is no salvation, no Prince Charming, only the reality of a vulnerable woman locked up by a man, who wants only one thing from her, her womanhood.
